"""Exact 600-frame Native stop proposal for the paved-highway branch.

Only `--check` is used in CPU preparation. Execution requires an original
highway survey and an exclusively owned CARLA server.
"""
import argparse
import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import queue
import shutil
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ASSIGNMENT = "training__C178965__NRS-484B-440-1__motor_vehicle_driver"
CASES = {ASSIGNMENT + "__probe_0" + str(i): mode for i, mode in
         ((1, "off_pavement"), (2, "on_pavement"), (3, "disabled_on_pavement"))}
VIEWS = ("overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference")


def require(ok, message):
    if not ok:
        raise ValueError(message)


def check(config):
    require(config["case_id"] in CASES and config["stop_mode"] == CASES[config["case_id"]],
            "case identity changed")
    require(config["law_id"] == "NRS-484B-440-1" and config["cell_id"] == "C178965"
            and config["actor"] == "motor_vehicle_driver", "assignment identity changed")
    require(config["frozen_cell"] == {"layout": "paved_road", "maneuver": "park", "control": "other_vehicle"}, "frozen cell changed")
    require(config["rate_hz"] == 20 and config["duration_s"] == 30 and config["frames"] == 600, "30-second capture required")
    require(tuple(c["name"] for c in config["cameras"]) == VIEWS, "four-camera plan missing")
    require(all(c["fps"] == 20 and c["width"] >= 1280 and c["height"] >= 720
                and len(c["location_xyz_m"]) == 3 and len(c["rotation_pyr_deg"]) == 3
                for c in config["cameras"]), "camera source configuration incomplete")
    require(config["physical_completion"] is False and config["legal_verdict"] is None, "unproved outcome claimed")
    return {"case_id": config["case_id"], "frame_count": 600, "rate_hz": 20,
            "views": list(VIEWS), "carla_contacted": False, "physical_completion": False}


def validate_survey(survey):
    require(survey["source_kind"] == "original_native_highway_survey", "original highway survey required")
    require(survey["map_name"] and survey["highway_source_id"] and survey["district_source_id"]
            and survey["pavement_edge_source_id"] and survey["offroad_area_source_id"]
            and survey["visibility_source_id"], "highway classification/geometry source missing")
    require(len(survey["spawn_xyz_yaw_deg"]) == 4 and len(survey["stop_target_xyz_m"]) == 3,
            "surveyed spawn or stop target missing")
    require(len(survey["other_spawn_xyz_yaw_deg"]) == 4, "other-vehicle spawn missing")
    require(set(survey.get("stop_targets_xyz_m", {})) == set(CASES.values()),
            "all three surveyed stop targets required")
    require(all(len(target) == 3 for target in survey["stop_targets_xyz_m"].values()),
            "surveyed stop target coordinate missing")
    require(survey.get("disabled_failure_source_id"), "disabled failure source missing")
    require(survey["district"] == "outside", "survey is inside a business/residence district")
    require(survey.get("public_highway_reviewed") is True,
            "public highway classification remains unreviewed")
    require(survey.get("pavement_left_y_m") < survey.get("pavement_right_y_m"),
            "pavement edge coordinates missing")
    require(survey.get("vehicle_half_width_m", 0) > 0,
            "vehicle footprint width missing")
    require(set(survey.get("approach_visibility_sources", {})) == {"forward", "backward"},
            "both approach visibility sources required")
    require(all(isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("source_id") and
                item.get("path_distance_m", 0) >= 60.96 and
                len(item.get("location_xyz_m", [])) == 3
                for item in survey["approach_visibility_sources"].values()),
            "both approach visibility sources required")
    half = survey["vehicle_half_width_m"]
    left, right = survey["pavement_left_y_m"], survey["pavement_right_y_m"]
    off_y = survey["stop_targets_xyz_m"]["off_pavement"][1]
    on_y = survey["stop_targets_xyz_m"]["on_pavement"][1]
    disabled_y = survey["stop_targets_xyz_m"]["disabled_on_pavement"][1]
    require(off_y - half >= right or off_y + half <= left,
            "off-pavement stop target overlaps traveled pavement")
    require(left < on_y + half and on_y - half < right and
            left < disabled_y + half and disabled_y - half < right,
            "on-pavement stop targets miss traveled pavement")
    return survey


def read_survey(path):
    return validate_survey(json.loads(Path(path).read_text()))


def approach_rays(world, ego, survey, carla):
    """Nine original geometric rays from each surveyed 200-foot station."""
    targets = [ego.get_transform().location, *ego.bounding_box.get_world_vertices(ego.get_transform())]
    rays = {}
    for direction, source in survey["approach_visibility_sources"].items():
        x, y, z = source["location_xyz_m"]
        origin = carla.Location(x=x, y=y, z=z)
        clear = []
        for target in targets:
            hits = world.cast_ray(origin, target)
            # A hit at the target body is not an intervening obstruction.
            clear.append(not hits or hits[0].location.distance(target) <= 1.0)
        rays[direction] = {"source_id": source["source_id"],
                           "path_distance_m": source["path_distance_m"],
                           "ray_clear": clear}
    return rays


def execute(config, output_dir, survey_path, host, port):
    check(config)
    require(survey_path, "original highway survey required")
    survey = read_survey(survey_path)
    require(".runtime-work" in os.environ.get("SCENARIO_PIPELINE_OUTPUT_ROOT", ""),
            "set SCENARIO_PIPELINE_OUTPUT_ROOT under .runtime-work")
    repo = ROOT.parents[2]
    sys.path.insert(0, str(repo / "runtime" / "scenario_pipeline"))
    sys.path.insert(1, str(repo / "runtime" / "python"))
    import carla
    from pipeline_capture import PipelineCapture
    from worker_exchange.native_output import FrameMap
    from worker_exchange.world_restore import restore, snapshot

    output = Path(output_dir)
    if output.exists():
        require((output / "config.json").is_file(), "existing output lacks materialized config")
    else:
        output.mkdir(parents=True)
    shutil.copyfile(survey_path, output / "original-highway-survey.json")
    client = carla.Client(host, port)
    client.set_timeout(15)
    world = client.get_world()
    original = snapshot(client)
    actors, sensors = [], []
    images = queue.Queue()
    try:
        require(world.get_map().name == survey["map_name"], "survey map differs")
        settings = world.get_settings()
        settings.synchronous_mode = True
        settings.fixed_delta_seconds = 0.05
        world.apply_settings(settings)
        library = world.get_blueprint_library()
        x, y, z, yaw = survey["spawn_xyz_yaw_deg"]
        ego = world.try_spawn_actor(library.find(config["vehicle_blueprint"]),
                                    carla.Transform(carla.Location(x=x, y=y, z=z), carla.Rotation(yaw=yaw)))
        require(ego is not None, "vehicle spawn occupied")
        actors.append(ego)
        ox, oy, oz, oyaw = survey["other_spawn_xyz_yaw_deg"]
        other = world.try_spawn_actor(library.find(config["vehicle_blueprint"]),
                                      carla.Transform(carla.Location(x=ox, y=oy, z=oz), carla.Rotation(yaw=oyaw)))
        require(other is not None, "other-vehicle spawn occupied")
        actors.append(other)
        for camera in config["cameras"]:
            blueprint = library.find("sensor.camera.rgb")
            blueprint.set_attribute("image_size_x", str(camera["width"]))
            blueprint.set_attribute("image_size_y", str(camera["height"]))
            blueprint.set_attribute("fov", str(camera["fov_deg"]))
            cx, cy, cz = camera["location_xyz_m"]
            pitch, cyaw, roll = camera["rotation_pyr_deg"]
            sensor = world.spawn_actor(blueprint, carla.Transform(carla.Location(x=cx, y=cy, z=cz),
                                       carla.Rotation(pitch=pitch, yaw=cyaw, roll=roll)), attach_to=ego)
            actors.append(sensor)
            sensors.append(sensor)
            (output / camera["name"]).mkdir()
            sensor.listen(lambda image, name=camera["name"]: images.put((name, image)))
        with PipelineCapture(client, ego, output, config["case_id"], required_observations=config["required_atoms"]) as capture, \
                FrameMap(output / "video_frames.jsonl") as frame_map, \
                (output / "roadside-native.jsonl").open("x", buffering=1) as trace, \
                (output / "visibility-native.jsonl").open("x", buffering=1) as visibility:
            for frame in range(600):
                pose, velocity = ego.get_transform(), ego.get_velocity()
                speed = math.sqrt(velocity.x**2 + velocity.y**2 + velocity.z**2)
                target = survey["stop_targets_xyz_m"][config["stop_mode"]]
                dx, dy = target[0] - pose.location.x, target[1] - pose.location.y
                distance = math.hypot(dx, dy)
                heading = math.atan2(dy, dx) - math.radians(pose.rotation.yaw)
                heading = math.atan2(math.sin(heading), math.cos(heading))
                steer = max(-0.65, min(0.65, 1.1 * heading))
                target_speed = min(5.0, max(0.0, 0.5 * distance))
                throttle = max(0.0, min(0.5, 0.18 + 0.12 * (target_speed - speed))) if distance > 1 else 0.0
                brake = max(0.0, min(1.0, 0.25 * (speed - target_speed))) if distance > 1 else 1.0
                failure_active = config["stop_mode"] == "disabled_on_pavement" and distance <= 1.0
                if failure_active:
                    # Construct an engine-command failure, with the brake held.
                    # Original trace and geometry still decide whether departure was impossible.
                    throttle, brake, steer = 0.0, 1.0, 0.0
                    ego.set_light_state(carla.VehicleLightState(carla.VehicleLightState.LeftBlinker |
                                                                 carla.VehicleLightState.RightBlinker))
                # A held parking brake records the constructed parked/standing
                # episode; duration and attendance still require source review.
                parking_brake = distance <= 1.0
                ego.apply_control(carla.VehicleControl(throttle=throttle, brake=brake,
                                                       steer=steer, hand_brake=parking_brake))
                other.apply_control(carla.VehicleControl(throttle=0.22, brake=0.0, steer=0.0))
                native_frame = world.tick()
                seen = set()
                while len(seen) < 4:
                    name, image = images.get(timeout=15)
                    if image.frame != native_frame or name in seen:
                        continue
                    image.save_to_disk(str(output / name / f"{frame:06d}.png"))
                    seen.add(name)
                capture.capture(native_frame, frame / 20, extra={"video_frame": frame,
                                                               "other_vehicle_actor_id": other.id})
                frame_map.append(native_frame, frame / 20,
                                 native_elapsed_s=world.get_snapshot().timestamp.elapsed_seconds)
                visibility.write(json.dumps({"source_kind": "original_native_raycast", "frame": frame,
                                             "native_frame": native_frame, "t_s": frame / 20,
                                             "approaches": approach_rays(world, ego, survey, carla)}) + "\n")
                pose, velocity = ego.get_transform(), ego.get_velocity()
                speed = math.sqrt(velocity.x**2 + velocity.y**2 + velocity.z**2)
                distance = math.hypot(target[0] - pose.location.x, target[1] - pose.location.y)
                trace.write(json.dumps({"source_kind": "original_native_observation", "frame": frame,
                                        "native_frame": native_frame, "t_s": frame / 20,
                                        "vehicle_id": ego.id, "x_m": pose.location.x, "y_m": pose.location.y,
                                        "other_vehicle_id": other.id,
                                        "other_x_m": other.get_transform().location.x,
                                        "other_y_m": other.get_transform().location.y,
                                        "speed_mps": speed, "bbox_half_width_m": ego.bounding_box.extent.y,
                                        "target_distance_m": distance, "stop_mode": config["stop_mode"],
                                        "parking_brake_commanded": parking_brake,
                                        "parking_brake_observed": ego.get_control().hand_brake,
                                        "failure_active": failure_active,
                                        "failure_source_id": survey["disabled_failure_source_id"] if failure_active else None}) + "\n")
    finally:
        for sensor in sensors:
            sensor.stop()
        for actor in reversed(actors):
            actor.destroy()
        restore(client, original)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir")
    parser.add_argument("--case", choices=tuple(CASES))
    parser.add_argument("--highway-survey")
    parser.add_argument("--host", default="127.0.0.1")
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=2000)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    cfg = json.loads((ROOT / "config.json").read_text())
    require(args.case is None or args.case == cfg["case_id"], "requested case differs from materialized construction")
    if args.check:
        print(json.dumps(check(cfg)))
    else:
        require(args.output_dir, "output directory required")
        execute(cfg, args.output_dir, args.highway_survey or os.environ.get("SCENARIO_HIGHWAY_SURVEY"), args.host, args.port)

"""Saved-only Native result for all three exact highway roadside cases."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from finalize_saved import summarize

CHANNELS = ("drv.standing_or_parked", "st.roadway", "st.shoulder", "rel.occupies",
            "st.lane_width", "st.sight_distance", "rel.visible", "sig.hazard",
            "kin.velocity", "st.road_edge")
CAMERAS = ("overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference")


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def require_source(attempt, name):
    path = attempt / name
    if not path.is_file():
        raise ValueError("Missing required source: " + name)
    return path


def measure_roadside(measurement, attempt):
    sources = ("roadside-native.jsonl", "visibility-native.jsonl",
               "original-highway-survey.json", "video_frames.jsonl")
    return {"value": {"stopped_frames": len(measurement["stopped"]),
                      "on_pavement_frames": sum(row["pavement_overlap_m"] > 0 for row in measurement["stopped"]),
                      "minimum_residual_width_m": min(row["opposite_unobstructed_width_m"] for row in measurement["stopped"]),
                      "all_stopped_frames_clear_at_200ft_forward_proxy": all(row["clear_200ft_forward_proxy"] for row in measurement["stopped"]),
                      "all_stopped_frames_clear_at_200ft_backward_proxy": all(row["clear_200ft_backward_proxy"] for row in measurement["stopped"]),
                      "injected_failure_frames": sum(row["failure_active"] for row in measurement["stopped"]),
                      "parking_brake_commanded_stopped_frames": sum(row["parking_brake_commanded"] for row in measurement["stopped"]),
                      "parking_brake_observed_stopped_frames": sum(row["parking_brake_observed"] for row in measurement["stopped"]),
                      "stopped_duration_s": round(len(measurement["stopped"]) / 20, 3),
                      "legal_result": None},
            "method": "measure_roadside",
            "sources": {name: sha(attempt / name) for name in sources}}


def finalize(attempt, output):
    from worker_exchange.native_output import write_result
    attempt, output = Path(attempt).resolve(), Path(output).resolve()
    if output.exists() or (attempt / "result.json").exists():
        raise ValueError("Retain prior saved roadside measurement")
    for name in ("config.json", "roadside-native.jsonl", "visibility-native.jsonl",
                 "original-highway-survey.json", "video_frames.jsonl", "trace.jsonl",
                 *(view + ".mkv" for view in CAMERAS)):
        require_source(attempt, name)
    config = json.loads((attempt / "config.json").read_text())
    case = config.get("selected_case_id")
    if not case or case != config.get("case_id"):
        raise ValueError("Selected exact roadside case differs")
    survey = json.loads((attempt / "original-highway-survey.json").read_text())
    diagnostic = survey.get("source_kind") == "synthetic_native_sample"
    measurement = summarize(attempt, case, diagnostic=diagnostic)
    channels = attempt / "channels"
    channels.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    original_rows = [json.loads(line) for line in (attempt / "roadside-native.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
    views = [json.loads(line) for line in (attempt / "visibility-native.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
    left, right = survey["pavement_left_y_m"], survey["pavement_right_y_m"]
    for name in CHANNELS:
        with (channels / (name + ".jsonl")).open("x") as stream:
            for body, view in zip(original_rows, views):
                value = {"native_frame": body["native_frame"],
                         "vehicle_id": body["vehicle_id"], "other_vehicle_id": body["other_vehicle_id"],
                         "speed_mps": body["speed_mps"], "vehicle_y_m": body["y_m"],
                         "half_width_m": body["bbox_half_width_m"],
                         "pavement_edges_y_m": [left, right],
                         "district": survey["district"],
                         "forward_200ft_rays": view["approaches"]["forward"]["ray_clear"],
                         "backward_200ft_rays": view["approaches"]["backward"]["ray_clear"],
                         "failure_active": body.get("failure_active") is True,
                         "parking_brake_commanded": body["parking_brake_commanded"],
                         "parking_brake_observed": body["parking_brake_observed"],
                         "diagnostic_fixture": diagnostic}
                stream.write(json.dumps({"time_s": body["t_s"], "value": value}) + "\n")
    observed = measure_roadside(measurement, attempt)
    result = {"case_id": case,
              "measured_values": {"roadside_stop": {"value": observed["value"],
                                   "source_hashes": observed["sources"], "legal_result": None}},
              "target_checks": [{"target": "sourced roadside stopped position and sight",
                  "requested": config["stop_mode"], "measured": observed["value"],
                  "method": "saved original trace, survey, ray and frame join",
                  "tolerance": 0, "matched": False, "physical_cause_confirmed": False,
                  "cause_evidence": list(observed["sources"])}],
              "setup_confirmed": False, "behavior_attempted": True,
              "maneuver_completed": False,
              "termination_reason": "Saved roadside measurements complete; physical review pending",
              "physical_failure_flags": ["original_highway_survey_and_sight_review_pending"],
              "trace_reference": "trace.jsonl",
              "video_references": [view + ".mkv" for view in CAMERAS],

class RunnerPlanTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.config = json.loads((Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "config.json").read_text())

    def test_exact_plan(self):
        proof = runner.check(self.config)
        self.assertEqual(proof["frame_count"], 600)
        self.assertEqual(len(proof["views"]), 4)
        self.assertFalse(proof["carla_contacted"])

    def test_mode_identity_rejected(self):
        self.config["stop_mode"] = "on_pavement" if self.config["stop_mode"] != "on_pavement" else "off_pavement"
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "case identity changed"):
            runner.check(self.config)

    def test_wrong_cell_rejected(self):
        self.config["cell_id"] = "wrong"
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "assignment identity changed"):
            runner.check(self.config)

    def test_short_capture_rejected(self):
        self.config["frames"] = 599
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "30-second capture required"):
            runner.check(self.config)

    def survey(self):
        return {"source_kind": "original_native_highway_survey",
                "map_name": "reviewed-map", "highway_source_id": "highway-review",
                "district_source_id": "frontage-review", "district": "outside",
                "public_highway_reviewed": True,
                "pavement_edge_source_id": "edge-survey", "offroad_area_source_id": "shoulder-survey",
                "visibility_source_id": "sight-survey",
                "approach_visibility_sources": {
                    "forward": {"source_id": "forward-ray", "path_distance_m": 60.96,
                                "location_xyz_m": [70.96, 2.8, 1.4]},
                    "backward": {"source_id": "backward-ray", "path_distance_m": 60.96,
                                 "location_xyz_m": [-50.96, 2.8, 1.4]}},
                "disabled_failure_source_id": "scenario-failure-trace",
                "spawn_xyz_yaw_deg": [0, 0, 0, 0], "other_spawn_xyz_yaw_deg": [-10, -2, 0, 0],
                "stop_target_xyz_m": [10, 2.8, 0],
                "stop_targets_xyz_m": {"off_pavement": [10, 5.0, 0],
                                       "on_pavement": [10, 2.8, 0],
                                       "disabled_on_pavement": [10, 2.8, 0]},
                "pavement_left_y_m": -3.5, "pavement_right_y_m": 3.5,
                "vehicle_half_width_m": 0.9}

    def test_three_distinct_surveyed_modes(self):
        survey = self.survey()
        self.assertIs(runner.validate_survey(survey), survey)
        survey["stop_targets_xyz_m"]["off_pavement"][1] = 3.0
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "off-pavement stop target overlaps"):
            runner.validate_survey(survey)

    def test_bidirectional_sight_source_required(self):
        survey = self.survey()
        del survey["approach_visibility_sources"]["backward"]
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "both approach visibility sources required"):
            runner.validate_survey(survey)

    def test_nine_rays_per_approach_and_intervening_obstruction(self):
        class Location:
            def __init__(self, x=0, y=0, z=0):
                self.x, self.y, self.z = x, y, z

            def distance(self, other):
                return ((self.x - other.x)**2 + (self.y - other.y)**2 +
                        (self.z - other.z)**2)**0.5

        Carla = type("Carla", (), {"Location": Location})

        class Box:
            def get_world_vertices(self, transform):
                return [Location(x=10, y=2.8, z=1.0) for _ in range(8)]

        class Ego:
            bounding_box = Box()

            def get_transform(self):
                return type("Transform", (), {"location": Location(x=10, y=2.8, z=1.0)})()

        class World:
            def cast_ray(self, origin, target):
                if origin.x < 0:
                    return [type("Hit", (), {"location": Location(x=0, y=2.8, z=1.0)})()]
                return []

        rays = runner.approach_rays(World(), Ego(), self.survey(), Carla)
        self.assertEqual(len(rays["forward"]["ray_clear"]), 9)
        self.assertTrue(all(rays["forward"]["ray_clear"]))
        self.assertFalse(any(rays["backward"]["ray_clear"]))

    unittest.main()

"""Fail-closed saved measurement of a surveyed NRS 484B.440(1) stop.

The 200-foot ray outcomes are geometric observations at surveyed approach
stations. They do not establish driver recognition or a legal conclusion.
"""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

ASSIGNMENT = "training__C178965__NRS-484B-440-1__motor_vehicle_driver"
FEET_200_M = 60.96


def require(value, message):
    if not value:
        raise ValueError(message)


def read_json_lines(path):
    path = Path(path)
    require(path.is_file(), "original source missing: " + path.name)
    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text().splitlines() if line]


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def summarize(attempt, case_id, *, diagnostic=False):
    attempt = Path(attempt)
    require(case_id in {ASSIGNMENT + "__probe_0" + str(i) for i in (1, 2, 3)},
            "case identity changed")
    paths = {key: attempt / name for key, name in
             (("trace", "roadside-native.jsonl"),
              ("visibility", "visibility-native.jsonl"),
              ("frames", "video_frames.jsonl"),
              ("survey", "original-highway-survey.json"))}
    for name, path in paths.items():
        require(path.is_file(), "original source missing: " + name)
    trace = read_json_lines(paths["trace"])
    visibility = read_json_lines(paths["visibility"])
    frames = read_json_lines(paths["frames"])
    survey = json.loads(paths["survey"].read_text())
    require(len(trace) == len(visibility) == len(frames) == 600,
            "incomplete 600-frame original source join")
    expected_survey_kind = "synthetic_native_sample" if diagnostic else "original_native_highway_survey"
    expected_trace_kind = "synthetic_native_sample" if diagnostic else "original_native_observation"
    expected_ray_kind = "synthetic_native_sample" if diagnostic else "original_native_raycast"
    require(survey.get("source_kind") == expected_survey_kind and
            survey.get("public_highway_reviewed") is True and survey.get("district") == "outside",
            "original highway or district source missing")
    require(survey.get("pavement_edge_source_id") and
            survey.get("offroad_area_source_id") and
            survey.get("visibility_source_id") and
            survey.get("disabled_failure_source_id"),
            "original road/shoulder/visibility/failure source missing")
    left, right = survey["pavement_left_y_m"], survey["pavement_right_y_m"]
    require(left < right, "invalid surveyed pavement edges")
    stopped = []
    for i, (body, view, frame) in enumerate(zip(trace, visibility, frames)):
        require(body.get("source_kind") == expected_trace_kind and
                view.get("source_kind") == expected_ray_kind and
                body.get("frame") == view.get("frame") == frame.get("video_frame") == i and
                body.get("native_frame") == view.get("native_frame") == frame.get("native_frame"),
                "original frame/time/source join failed")
        require(abs(body.get("t_s", -1) - i / 20) < 1e-8 and
                abs(view.get("t_s", -1) - i / 20) < 1e-8,
                "noncontiguous 20 Hz source time")
        require(set(view.get("approaches", {})) == {"forward", "backward"},
                "both directional visibility rays required")
        for direction, rays in view["approaches"].items():
            require(rays.get("source_id") == survey["approach_visibility_sources"][direction]["source_id"] and
                    rays.get("path_distance_m") >= FEET_200_M and
                    len(rays.get("ray_clear", [])) == 9 and
                    all(isinstance(value, bool) for value in rays["ray_clear"]),
                    "incomplete 200-foot original rays: " + direction)
        require(body.get("vehicle_id") and body.get("other_vehicle_id") and
                body.get("speed_mps", -1) >= 0 and body.get("bbox_half_width_m", 0) > 0,
                "original participants or footprint missing")
        require(isinstance(body.get("parking_brake_commanded"), bool) and
                isinstance(body.get("parking_brake_observed"), bool),
                "parking brake command/observation source missing")
        if body["speed_mps"] > 0.1:
            continue
        half = body["bbox_half_width_m"]
        low, high = body["y_m"] - half, body["y_m"] + half
        overlap = max(0.0, min(right, high) - max(left, low))
        stopped.append({"frame": i, "native_frame": body["native_frame"],
                        "pavement_overlap_m": round(overlap, 5),
                        "opposite_unobstructed_width_m": round(right - left - overlap, 5),
                        "clear_200ft_forward_proxy": any(view["approaches"]["forward"]["ray_clear"]),
                        "clear_200ft_backward_proxy": any(view["approaches"]["backward"]["ray_clear"]),
                        "parking_brake_commanded": body["parking_brake_commanded"],
                        "parking_brake_observed": body["parking_brake_observed"],
                        "failure_active": body.get("failure_active") is True})
    require(stopped, "no stopped episode measured")
    return {"format": "c178965-original-saved-measurement-v1", "case_id": case_id,
            "diagnostic_fixture": diagnostic,
            "source_sha256": {key: sha(path) for key, path in paths.items()},
            "frame_count": 600, "stopped": stopped,
            "district": survey["district"], "legal_result": None,
            "limitations": ["Ray clear is a 200-foot geometric proxy, not recognizability",
                            "Parking brake and stopped duration do not establish attendance or legal purpose",
                            "Free passage and off-part practicability remain independent judgments",
                            "Disability injection does not prove unavoidable temporary stopping"]}


def main():
    import argparse
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--attempt", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--case", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--diagnostic", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    output = Path(args.output)
    if output.exists():
        raise ValueError("retain prior measurement output")
    output.write_text(json.dumps(summarize(args.attempt, args.case, diagnostic=args.diagnostic), sort_keys=True) + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
